entry.title: Spring 0.4.1
entry.summary: Repackaged for the Open MPC plugin catalog. The plugin binaries are the same ones from 0.4.0. What changed is the packaging: catalog ids now start with `op1fx-` (for example `op1fx-delay`), the installer matches the current mpc-vst-plugins template, and the repo carries MPC screenshots and a `tested.json`. Tested on an MPC Live III (Gen2), MPC OS 3.9.1. The armv7 zips (Gen1, Force, MPC One) are built but not tested on hardware yet. Download `OP1-Suite-0.4.1-mpc-aarch64.zip` to install all twenty
